fileSelection.title: Select or Upload Files
fileSelection.deleteConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this file? This action cannot be undone.
fileSelection.uploadInterrupted: Transfer interrupted. The file list was refreshed — anything that had already reached the server may still appear.

uploadFailed.transfer_stalled: {filename}: Upload stalled at {percent}% — the connection stopped sending data before the file reached the server. This is usually a dropped connection or an upload size/timeout limit on a proxy. Check your connection and try again; if it keeps failing, the file may be too large for the current server limit.
uploadFailed.server_timeout: {filename}: The file finished uploading but the server did not respond in time. It may still have been saved — wait a moment and check the list before retrying.
uploadFailed.too_large: {filename}: The server rejected this file as too large. Try a smaller file or ask your administrator to raise the upload limit.
uploadFailed.forbidden: {filename}: The upload was blocked by a security layer (firewall/proxy) before reaching the server. This usually isn't something you can fix — please contact the team so they can allow this upload.
uploadFailed.gateway: {filename}: The server is temporarily unavailable (error {status}). Please try again in a moment.
uploadFailed.server_error: {filename}: The server hit an error while saving this file (error {status}). Please try again.
uploadFailed.network: {filename}: The connection was lost during the upload. Check your network and try again.
uploadFailed.invalid_response: {filename}: The server returned an unexpected response. Please try again.
